0791537537113.sourceDescription: Effortless Pull Up Design: This 5ft artificial Christmas tree features a smart collapsible pop up design, allowing for rapid assembly and disassembly within minutes. Supported by a robust central metal support pole, it stands stably while occupying minimal floor space, making it a great holiday decoration choice for small living rooms, apartments, narrow hallways, and office corners. Luxury Ombre Gold and Star Sequins: Crafted with premium metallic foil tinsel that transitions elegantly from a bright gold top to a warm copper gold base. Interspersed with numerous shiny star sequins, this slim pencil tree catches ambient lights from all angles, creating a stunning glistening effect for modern or classic festive themes. Bonus Gold Star Tree Topper Included: Each collapsible tinsel tree comes with a free complimentary hollow-carved gold star tree topper. This beautiful star ornament fits securely onto the top branch, adding a classic, crowning finishing touch that elevates your festive display without requiring you to purchase separate treetop accessories. Complimentary LED Star String Lights: The package also includes a free 4.5-metre battery-operated string light containing 30 warm LEDs with star and snowball-shaped covers. The cosy, enchanting glow weaves smoothly through the ombre gold branches, immediately creating a rich, welcoming holiday atmosphere across your entire indoor space. Sturdy Frame and Flat Storage: Engineered with a heavy-duty steel core frame and a four-legged floor base, this narrow coastal tree avoids tilting or wobbling. The flexible spiral structure allows the entire body to fold down into a completely flat shape, ensuring easy, flat, space-saving storage in a compact box when the winter season ends.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show

A flexible finishing touch

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Add champagne colour and contrasting texture to your Christmas decorations with this pack of 3 matching 10cm thread ball baubles. Each round ornament has a thread-wrapped surface with an iridescent sequin band around the middle, bringing together fine lines and reflective detail in one design. The 10cm size creates a visible accent among foliage, ribbons and other hanging ornaments, while the champagne finish helps you coordinate a consistent seasonal colour scheme. Hanging Tree Ornaments: A loop above the decorative cap provides a hanging point for each bauble. Position the 10cm ornaments on suitable branches or incorporate them into a wreath or garland, spacing them between other decorations so the thread texture and sequin band remain visible.
Coordinated Christmas Decor: Use the champagne colour to build a consistent tree theme, or combine the baubles with contrasting ornaments and ribbon. The round shape suits traditional Christmas decorations, winter wedding displays and festive party arrangements around the home.
Display And Pack Contents: Includes 3 matching decorative balls for a repeated accent, each measuring 10cm. Add to indoor window arrangements, mantel greenery or a decorated tree, then coordinate with your own bows, foliage and seasonal accessories for a display throughout the festive season.

Use one as a centrepiece, place a pair either side of a doorway, or combine different sizes to create a glowing forest effect in the garden or a large room. 5096042277413.variantName: Christmas door wreath - Decorative pine cone wreath with cotton bolls and printed ribbon for festive doors and tables - 30 cm
5096042277413.sourceDescription:
Cotton bolls and pine cones bring contrasting textures to the PVC greenery. A ribbon printed with the words Just for you gives this 30 cm wreath a personal detail, particularly if you are choosing it as a festive gift.

A wreath puts the decoration on the door or wall itself, leaving the console or mantelpiece below free for cards and winter flowers. Its outline is complete in one piece, which is handy in an entrance where there is little space for a tree. From a few steps away the cones read as dark accents. Closer up, their overlapping scales contrast with the finer foliage. A simple ribbon or a nearby wooden decoration will pick up that woodland detail.

The centre opening lets the background play a part in the design. Pale paint gives the foliage a sharp outline, while a darker panel draws attention to the texture at the tips of the branches. When you unpack the greenery, support the wreath from behind and ease any compressed outer sprigs apart gently. Turn the wreath as you work so that you can check the outline from the front as well as from the side.

A green wreath also works as a bridge between rooms.

For a wall arrangement, try the wreath above a narrow console with the centre of the design just below eye level. A clear strip of wall between the wreath and the furniture shows off the outline and leaves the surface free for keys or Christmas cards. If you already have a busy Christmas tree, give the wreath a space of its own. A quiet patch of wall brings the outline into focus and gives visitors a chance to see the individual details as they pass.

A simple way to plan the setting is to mark the centre of the intended space with a small piece of paper. Hold the decoration over it, then step back to see how it sits alongside the door surround or other wall decorations.

Durable PVC greenery construction ensures long-lasting seasonal decoration year after year

5096825937213.sourceDescription:
Christmas Garland
Adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. Key details include reusable design and woven texture.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Woven Texture
The woven construction gives the surface a structured textile pattern. Its visible texture adds detail to the overall appearance.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Dimensions: 50 Cm. Quantity: 12 pack.
Reusable festive garland with a structured woven texture for lasting holiday decor.
Versatile 50 cm length suitable for both indoor and outdoor Christmas displays.
Comes in a convenient 12-pack to provide ample quantity for extensive decorating.
Designed with a durable polyester construction that is easy to clean and store.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor & outdoor use

 This vibrant autumn‑themed artificial wreath is full‑bloom designed, dominated by bright sunflowers, mixed with multi‑color roses, seasonal autumn foliage and tiny wild‑looking filler flowers.

Strong Decorative Construction – The metal frame gives each gift box a structured shape that helps the display look neat and well presented throughout the season.
Classic Christmas Styling – The wrapped-present design offers a timeless festive look that works well with a wide range of Christmas themes and colour schemes.
Easy to Reuse Each Year – A practical seasonal decoration that can be packed away after Christmas and brought back out for future festive displays.

This inflatable santa adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red finish and polyester construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Polyester. Colour: Red. Product measurements: length 190 cm, width 72 cm, height 122 cm. Product weight: 0.9 kg. Quantity: 1 piece.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

This inflatable gingerbread decoration features six inner lights that illuminate brightly in the dark, creating a vibrant atmosphere for your garden or patio. The candy cane and three gift bags are lit up to enhance the festive look wherever it stands. It serves as an eye-catching seasonal ornament that adds warmth to outdoor spaces during the winter months.

The water-resistant polyester shell is tough and retains its shape and vibrancy throughout the season. Rated IP44, this shell makes the decoration safe for mild weather conditions outdoors, protecting against light rain and moisture.

Six ground stakes, two guy ropes and two sandbags are included to keep the inflatable weighted and securely in place against windy weather. These accessories ensure stability, preventing the decoration from tipping over or moving unexpectedly during gusts.

Easy-inflate operation allows you to simply plug the decoration into the mains to blow it up quickly and efficiently. To deflate, just unplug from power, making storage simple and convenient after the festive period ends. The process requires no complex setup, enabling instant transformation of your outdoor space into a cheerful holiday scene.

The dimensions of 245H x 170W x 100Dcm provide a substantial presence suitable for front yards and large patios. A three-metre power cable offers flexibility in positioning the unit near available electrical outlets for safe connection. The assembled weight of 1.9kg keeps it manageable while ensuring it feels solid when inflated.
